In detail

Sources genuinely disagree on this district and both are disclosed rather than one being picked. A private 2020 Otodom resident-safety survey (120,000+ respondents) rated Bronowice the single safest district in the city (4.05/5), citing its guarded, monitored residential developments popular with families. The City of Kraków's own official resident-safety survey (end of 2022, published January 2023) found the opposite: only 75.1% of Bronowice residents rated their own district as safe, placing it among the lowest-rated districts in that official survey — a marked reversal from the private survey two years earlier. No specific dated incident reporting was found to explain the shift either way. Sources checked: Otodom District Ranking 2020; City of Kraków official resident-safety survey, krakow.pl (published January 2023).
